features: FITS PLENTY OF ITEMS! - Whether its food, pharmaceuticals, or electronic items, these 1-quart Mylar bags have plenty of space for everything, and the oxygen absorbers cover it all!
EASY TO SEAL! - Use a hot iron to heat seal these bags shut and keep everything out, and reseal them again after opening if need be!
KEEP YOUR ITEMS DRY! - These moisture barrier bags keep all items completely free from water damage when sealed!
ABSOLUTELY AIRTIGHT! - Once sealed with the oxygen absorbers inside, these bags won't let any air in, eliminating any worries about rust or other pollution!

description: These Dry-Packs 1 Quart Mylar Bags with Moisture & Static Shielding and 100cc Oxygen Absorbers are made from multiple layers of Mylar and aluminum, making them both durable and secure for whatever items you might be shipping or storing. The flexible structure makes it easy to heat seal with hot iron, effectively blocking out moisture or any other damaging factors. Best of all, these bags are resealable after opening, allowing for repeated use, and the oxygen absorbers keep your goods free of contamination. . Whether you're storing metal or electronic equipment, pharmaceuticals, or food for long periods of time, these bags are perfect for keeping items in an airtight environment. With a low oxygen and moisture transmission rate as well as high light and puncture resistance coupled with the included oxygen absorbing packs, these bags are perfect for keeping your goods completely unaffected by any issues that may occur during long term storage. Our moisture and static shielding bags are the superior storage bags in the industry, and a perfect anti-corrosion solution for food and metal items. Combine these bags with the included Oxy-Sorb 100cc Oxygen Absorbing Packets if you're storing dry foods or other goods for long periods of time and want to keep them free of mold or other contamination. Each packet covers a 1-quart space, making them the perfect match for these 1-quart bags. Includes 80 bags and 80 Oxy-Sorb packets. Bag walls are 4. 75mil thick.
